verdict.rationale: Solid separates reactive state into an explicit accessor and setter (count()/setCount()) and builds derived state from plain functions. Only the code that depends on a piece of state reruns, and components run once, so state changes are easy to trace. A long-term user confirms the immediate reactive system keeps state changes intuitive and easy to debug, though another reports devtools are alpha/unusable and users flag reactivity-loss pitfalls with destructured props. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of unidirectional flow versus two-way binding, mature tooling for tracing state changes, and lint/type safeguards against silent reactivity loss.
